extension.summary: An Android TV style skin that organizes your library by service.
extension.description: Backlot groups your local movies and TV shows under the network or studio that made them (Peacock, HBO Max, Netflix, Paramount+, Disney+ and more), with an Android TV / Google TV style home screen.
extension.news: v0.5.4 - New Collections tile logo. v0.5.3 - Collections tile and Collections header, collections kept together under one service, and Back never lands on the Videos menu (it goes home). v0.5.2 - Max is called HBO Max again (existing setups are renamed unless you renamed it yourself). v0.5.1 - Paused info screen now appears when you pause from the on-screen controls (they close after 5 idle seconds). v0.5.0 - New player: paused info screen, chapter marks and names on the progress bar, current subtitle and audio on the OSD, Backlot-styled Up Next card (install it from Backlot settings or setup), and the progress bar no longer shows a solid white track. v0.4.9 - File manager is back in Settings (add sources, copy, move, rename, delete). v0.4.8 - Info screens and episode lists no longer start a line with a stray dot when a director or runtime is missing. v0.4.7 - Check for Backlot updates button in settings. v0.4.6 - Services now include the studios their companies own (Paramount Pictures in Paramount+, MGM in Prime Video and more). Discovery+ inside Max option. Clearer studios report with one-step new services.
